short_description: Download & Save GoHighLevel Videos Easily for Offline Viewing (Browser Extension)
long_description: GoHighLevel Downloader is a browser extension built for users who want a simpler way to save training and course videos from GoHighLevel-powered portals. It works with supported GoHighLevel-hosted streams and common embedded lesson providers, giving you a browser-first workflow for detecting the lesson video, choosing a quality, and exporting an MP4 file you can replay later.

faqs.question: What kinds of GoHighLevel videos can I download?
faqs.answer: Supported GoHighLevel lesson videos plus supported embedded lesson players inside GoHighLevel portals and memberships.

faqs.question: Do I need to press play first?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many lesson streams are only exposed after playback begins.

faqs.question: What file format do downloads use?
faqs.answer: Videos are saved as MP4 files.

faqs.question: Does it support embedded lesson providers?
faqs.answer: Yes. Supported platforms include Loom, Vimeo, Wistia, and YouTube when they appear on supported GoHighLevel pages.

faqs.question: Do I need extra software?
faqs.answer: No. Everything runs through the browser extension.

permissions.description: Only download content you own or have explicit permission to save

features: Video detection for GoHighLevel portal, course, and membership pages
Embedded lesson support for Loom, Vimeo, Wistia, and YouTube
Quality selection for available stream resolutions
MP4 export for easier offline playback and sharing
Popup workflow for reviewing detected lesson media
Concurrent download support for supported workflows
Cross-browser support for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, Whale, and Yandex

why: GoHighLevel portals often mix native video delivery with embedded training players like Loom, Vimeo, Wistia, and YouTube.
GoHighLevel Downloader focuses on supported portal and membership pages, detects available lesson media in the browser session, and saves accessible training content as MP4.
how_it_works: Install the extension from the latest release.
Open a GoHighLevel membership, course lesson, or portal page with video.
Start playback so the extension can detect the lesson media.
Open the popup to review available stream options.
Download the lesson and save the final MP4 file locally.
supported_formats: Input: Supported embedded Loom, Vimeo, Wistia, and YouTube players
use_cases: Save a GoHighLevel course lesson for offline study.
Download training videos from a membership portal.
Archive your own uploaded video lessons.
Save embedded Loom or Vimeo walkthroughs inside GoHighLevel.
Keep local copies of training content before access changes.
troubleshooting: If the lesson video is not detected, press play first and wait a few seconds.
Some pages expose a single playable stream variant.
If the wrong player source is picked up, refresh after the lesson player fully loads.
The extension only works on content you can already access in your active GoHighLevel session.
trial_access: Email sign-in uses one-time password verification.
No credit card required for the trial.
Unlimited downloads are available with a paid license.
installation_instructions: Download the extension build for your browser.
Open a GoHighLevel lesson or membership page.
Use the extension popup to detect and download the video.
notes: Only download content you own or have explicit permission to save.
The extension only works on media you can already play in your browser session.
Video quality depends on the source stream exposed on that lesson page.
An internet connection is required for the initial download.
